task: You've joined an online shop's checkout team, and the cart needs code behind it. Build it from the real product file: search the catalogue, manage a cart, price it the way the order system does, write a receipt file, and refuse the awkward cases.

produce.name: catalogue.py
produce.about: The catalogue, the cart, the pricing rules, the receipt writer and the safe way to add a sale.

produce.name: main.py
produce.about: Runs each step on the product file and prints its result.

produce.name: receipt.txt
produce.about: One line per product, then subtotal, shipping, tax and total in dollars.

steps.P01.m1: Index the products by id and search names still on sale, ignoring case.
steps.P01.m2: Add products to a cart, change quantities, and count the units.
steps.P01.m3: Price the cart in cents, with shipping and tax.
steps.P01.m4: Write the receipt file, one line per product and then the totals.
steps.P01.m5: Refuse unknown products, discontinued products and quantities below 1.

problems: 23 of the 328 products are discontinued and must not be found or sold.
Product names mix capitals, so a search has to ignore case.
Prices are decimals: 39 of them come out a cent short if you multiply by 100 and drop the fraction instead of rounding.
